title: VectraYX-Nano：42M参数的西班牙语网络安全语言模型
summary: VectraYX-Nano是一个42M参数的西班牙语网络安全语言模型，从头训练，支持拉丁美洲语境和MCP原生工具调用。贡献包括：170M token的西班牙语网络安全语料库、带课程学习与重放的持续预训练、以及工具调用能力。模型仅81MB，可在llama.cpp上亚秒级运行，是首个端到端MCP集成的西班牙语网络安全LLM。
summary_en: VectraYX-Nano is a 42M-parameter Spanish cybersecurity LLM trained from scratch with Latin-American focus and native MCP tool invocation. Key contributions: a 170M-token Spanish cybersecurity corpus, curriculum learning with replay, and tool-use capability. The 81MB GGUF artifact runs sub-second on commodity hardware, making it the first Spanish-native cybersecurity LLM with end-to-end MCP integration.
